Description: **Huawei Cloud Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)** has **VPC Flow Logs** enabled to capture accepted and rejected IP traffic across network interfaces.
Risk: Without **VPC Flow Logs**, network intrusions, lateral movement, and anomalous outbound connections cannot be investigated or detected effectively.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)** > **Flow Logs**.
3. Click **Create Flow Log**.
4. Select **VPC** as the resource type, choose the target VPC, and bind an **LTS log group and stream**.
5. Click **OK**.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **VPC Flow Logs** on all VPCs and stream traffic metadata to **LTS** for security monitoring and forensics.
